name: ONNX Runtime
short_description: Motor de inferência multiplataforma da Microsoft para modelos ONNX, com provedores de execução como CUDA e TensorRT.

evidence.quote: Para o runtime ONNX, despeje as prioridades de EP.
PyTorch is used for export, then on X runtime or 10-so-RT takes over for inference.
The core artifact is execution provider order in ON and X runtime.
